answers.core: This suggestion is for improving GDScript functionality out of the box. I assume that new keywords are not eligible to be add-on content.
answers.workaround: I don't believe so. I checked the docs, internet, and Godot Café discord, but I didn't find anything that would solve this issue. If there is already a built-in way to achieve what I'm proposing, I'd be grateful for knowledge of it.

title: Add "protected" Keyword to GDScript - Prevents Modifying Members in the Inspector at Runtime
